content: In the R. al-Inzāliyya Ibn Turka states that it is specifically the lettrists (ahl al-ḥarf) who must be considered the associates of the Prophet Muḥammad and his true heirs; they are the ones who understand the meanings of the letters in their three forms, numerological, symbological and phonological. Melvin-Koushki says this removes all doubt about the identity of the seventh level.
